8/8 全部转 DONE。汇总：

| exp_id | conclusion | key metrics | 操作 |
|--------|-----------|-------------|------|
| train_smart_compress_m128_resume | success | loss=0.054, steps=99999 | 直接→DONE |
| train_smart_compress_m128_seed43 | success | loss=0.056, eval=0.061, steps=99999 | 补metrics→DONE |
| train_smart_compress_m16_seed43 | success | loss=0.077, eval=0.062, steps=99999 | 补metrics→DONE |
| train_smart_compress_m16_seed44_v3 | success | loss=0.068, eval=0.050, steps=99999 | 补checkpoint_path+log_path+metrics→DONE |
| train_smart_compress_m64_seed44 | success | loss=0.031, eval=0.070, steps=99999 | 补conclusion+metrics→DONE |
| train_smart_compress_m32_seed44 | success | loss=0.041, eval=0.064, steps=99999 | 补conclusion+metrics→DONE |
| train_smart_compress_m96_seed44 | success | loss=0.047, eval=0.053, steps=99999 | 补conclusion+metrics→DONE |
| **eval_pi05_random_k09_fixedmask_object_seed42_v2** | **negative** | **SR=17.0% (85/500)** | 补conclusion+metrics→DONE |

**fixedmask v2 关键结论**：per-episode 固定 random mask (k=0.9) SR=17.0%，与 stochastic random k=0.9 的 ~10-12% SR 相比仅微幅提升，远未恢复到 baseline (~90%)。**temporal inconsistency 不是 k=0.9 cliff 的根因，specific tokens are critical** — 即使只丢弃 10% 的 token，如果丢掉了关键 token，性能就会崩塌。
